style: Use AGENTS.md Image Generation Prompt For Tafsir Filmstrip Backgrounds. Generate 16:9 landscape, center-safe, no text, no script, no close people or animals, no prophets, no angels, no depiction of Allah, no literal Paradise or Hell.

knownReview.reason: Contains a book/stand despite the no-manuscripts rule.
Important balanced stones are close to side edges; portrait crop may lose the metaphor.
Water flask/footprints may be too close to an edge for portrait crop.
Large foreground rock may compete with lower-center text overlay.
Column texture resembles carvings; acceptable only if it does not read as text in-app.
Crown-like shadow is too literal and occupies lower-center text space.

topics.name: Намаз (ас-салят)
topics.meaning: Worship, humility, discipline, turning back to guidance.
topics.avoid: No mosque-interior cliché, no visible faces, no calligraphy.
metaphors: quiet dawn courtyard with clean open floor
soft light entering a simple prayer space without symbols
desert horizon before sunrise with ordered footprints
rain-washed stone and a calm open sky

topics.name: Смерть
topics.meaning: Mortality, return, the passing nature of worldly life.
topics.avoid: No corpses, graves as horror, gore, or despair.
metaphors: fallen leaf on still water at dusk
empty path disappearing into mist
dry field with a single new shoot after rain
fading sunset over quiet ruins

topics.name: Коран
topics.meaning: Guidance, reminder, light, mercy, and clarity.
topics.avoid: No books, scrolls, pages, letters, or calligraphy.
metaphors: path of light after rain on dry earth
lantern glow on a stone path with no writing
dawn breaking through clouds over a valley
clear water flowing through dark stones

topics.name: Очищение (ат-тазкия)
topics.meaning: Purification of self, cleansing, growth after repentance.
topics.avoid: No ritual close-ups, no faces, no written symbols.
metaphors: rain cleansing dusty leaves
clear stream over pale stones
white morning mist lifting from a garden
cracked earth softened by first rain

topics.name: Справедливость
topics.meaning: Balance, fairness, uprightness, truth over oppression.
topics.avoid: No courtrooms, no political symbols, no text.
metaphors: balanced stones beside calm water
straight path between shadow and light
two trees reflected evenly in a still pool
sunrise over a level horizon after storm

topics.name: Скромность (тавадуъ)
topics.meaning: Humility, restraint, quiet dignity before truth.
topics.avoid: No portrait, no heroic figure, no poverty cliché.
metaphors: small wildflower beneath vast mountains
low valley under an immense sky
simple cup catching rain on stone
narrow footpath through tall quiet grass

topics.name: Равенство
topics.meaning: Human equality before judgment, shared origin and dignity.
topics.avoid: No faces, no crowds, no flags, no slogans.
metaphors: many paths meeting at one open plain
different stones under the same rain
equal rows of young plants in morning light
shared shade beneath a wide tree with no people

topics.name: Брак (никах)
topics.meaning: Mercy, tranquility, covenant, protection, and family responsibility.
topics.avoid: No romance pose, no faces, no wedding symbols.
metaphors: two trees growing beside one stream
paired lamps casting one warm pool of light
shelter in rain with two empty places
two paths joining into a garden trail

topics.name: Клятвы (аль-айман)
topics.meaning: Responsibility of speech, promises, accountability.
topics.avoid: No written contracts, no hands swearing, no symbols.
metaphors: single rope bridge over a quiet ravine
stone cairn marking a path at dusk
clear reflection disturbed by one ripple
sealed gate and open road beyond

topics.name: Паломничество (аль-хадж)
topics.meaning: Journey, obedience, leaving comfort for worship and remembrance.
topics.avoid: No Kaaba, no crowds, no identifiable pilgrims, no mosque cliché.
metaphors: long desert road toward dawn
empty valley path between pale mountains
simple water flask beside footprints in sand
wide plain under stars before sunrise

topics.name: Развод (талаq)
topics.meaning: Separation, restraint, fairness, grief handled with responsibility.
topics.avoid: No couples, no faces, no domestic drama.
metaphors: two paths parting gently in a field
broken branch healing with new growth
empty doorway with morning light outside
river dividing around a quiet island

topics.name: Награда верующих
topics.meaning: Hope, mercy, promised reward without depicting the unseen.
topics.avoid: No literal Paradise, no palaces, no supernatural beings.
metaphors: distant green valley after a hard climb
shade and water after desert heat
golden dawn beyond a dark ridge
garden gate suggested by trees, not architecture

topics.name: Воскрешение (аль-Кыяма)
topics.meaning: Renewal after death, awakening, certainty of return.
topics.avoid: No graves opening, no bodies, no apocalypse spectacle.
metaphors: dead earth sprouting after rain
seedling breaking through cracked ground
winter field touched by first spring light
dry riverbed beginning to flow again

topics.name: Сыны Исраиля
topics.meaning: Community history, covenant, tests, gratitude and heedlessness.
topics.avoid: No named figures, no faces, no ethnic caricature, no crowds.
metaphors: ancient empty road through desert stones
weathered city gate at dawn
scattered footprints near a dry valley
old caravan route under stars with no people

topics.name: Иудеи (аль-яхуд)
topics.meaning: People of Scripture, covenant, dispute, reminder and accountability.
topics.avoid: No stereotypes, no religious symbols, no faces, no text.
metaphors: old stone path between two walls
quiet archive-like architecture without books or writing
branching roads under a cloudy sky
ancient olive trees in evening light

topics.name: Христиане (ан-насара)
topics.meaning: People of Scripture, devotion, disagreement, and invitation to truth.
topics.avoid: No crosses, churches as symbols, clergy, faces, or text.
metaphors: distant hill settlement in soft mist
two rivers meeting under morning light
old stone steps with sunlight but no symbols
olive grove after rain

topics.name: Ибрахим
topics.meaning: Pure monotheism, trust, rejection of false worship, trial and steadfastness.
topics.avoid: Do not depict Ibrahim, idols, fire miracle, family, or faces.
metaphors: empty desert under clear stars
single path away from a dark city toward dawn
broken shadow of false monuments without recognizable idols
solitary tent-like shelter in vast open land with no people

topics.name: Юсуф
topics.meaning: Patience, chastity, trial, hidden wisdom, eventual relief.
topics.avoid: Do not depict Yusuf, family, prison scenes with people, faces, or seduction.
metaphors: light entering an empty stone chamber
deep well seen as abstract dark circle with sky reflection
green field after long drought
closed door with dawn light beneath it

topics.name: Нух
topics.meaning: Warning, patience, rejection, flood as trial and deliverance.
topics.avoid: Do not depict Nuh, ark with people, drowning bodies, or spectacle.
metaphors: storm clouds over a vast plain
rain beginning over dry timber and hills, no boat focus
distant high ridge above floodwater
single beam of light after heavy rain

topics.name: Лут
topics.meaning: Moral corruption, warning, protection, consequences.
topics.avoid: No sexual content, no people, no violence, no literal punishment spectacle.
metaphors: abandoned city street under heavy storm clouds
salt-white barren plain after night rain
closed gates in a dark valley
dawn over ruins with no bodies

topics.name: Худ
topics.meaning: Warning to a proud people, arrogance before signs, ruin after denial.
topics.avoid: Do not depict Hud or his people; no faces, no disaster spectacle.
metaphors: wind over empty ancient ruins
desert pillars half-buried in sand
storm approaching a silent city
sunlit path away from eroded stone halls

topics.name: Салих
topics.meaning: A sign rejected, arrogance, accountability, fragile mercy.
topics.avoid: Do not depict Salih, the she-camel, people, or punishment.
metaphors: carved stone dwellings empty at sunrise
lonely mountain pass after storm
dry valley with a protected spring
cracked rock lit by soft dawn

topics.name: Сулейман
topics.meaning: Wisdom, power as trust, gratitude, order in creation.
topics.avoid: Do not depict Sulayman, throne, jinn, animals as portraits, or royal spectacle.
metaphors: wind moving over ordered terraces
sunlit valley seen from a high quiet overlook
empty polished courtyard after rain without symbols
balanced garden channels under morning light

topics.name: Юнус
topics.meaning: Distress, repentance, mercy after darkness.
topics.avoid: Do not depict Yunus, whale/fish close-up, body, or literal inside creature.
metaphors: small light beneath dark ocean surface
stormy sea calming at dawn
lonely shore after night waves
deep blue water with a distant ray of light

topics.name: История с Фараоном
topics.meaning: Tyranny, arrogance, oppression, and the collapse of false power.
topics.avoid: Do not depict Musa, Pharaoh, bodies, armies, faces, or spectacle.
metaphors: monumental empty halls fading into sand
river at dawn beside abandoned stone steps
storm over distant ancient city
broken crown-like shadow without literal crown or symbols
